name: visual-prompt-architect
description: Editorial template system with auto-designed shell, default Hero, balanced masonry image panels, themed photo frames, region source mapping, and 30 presets.

interface.longDescription: Builds reusable editorial-style infographic, poster, newsletter, and one-page templates with coordinated background/header/footer shells, default Hero sections, balanced masonry photo panels, theme-matched frames, region-specific reference mapping, and preserve-first asset handling.
defaultPrompt: Create a professional poster prompt from my requirements and reference images.
Design an infographic prompt using A4 portrait unless I specify otherwise.
Review my poster requirements and build the strongest visual direction before writing the final prompt.
